text:
ellie: Heads up — vendor flagged a customs hold on a shipment of ~50 H100s bound for EU edge pool (fra-warehouse). They are asking for additional RMA paperwork and a certificate of origin before release. ETA now uncertain.

samir: Ugh. Do we have AWB + serial manifest? Can we get photos?

ellie: I have the manifest but vendor says customs requires repaired/return paperwork for part-shipments. AWB: CARGO-FTX-894512. Serial batch: sent privately.

maria: Tagging procurement: We need options: 1) expedite air replacement (premium cost), 2) split-ship loaners from our US spare pool, 3) accept delay and adjust customer commitments. Any cost estimates?

jo: Cluster impact — eu-west1 edge pool will drop ~12% capacity if these stay blocked. Canary traffic scheduled tomorrow morning might experience tail latency rises. Recommend moving 8 reserved capacity GPUs from non-critical pools to maintain SLAs.

alex: We can spin up short-lived cloud-backed Dedicated nodes in the region for critical routes, but that takes ~90m to warm the KV cache. Tradeoff is cost vs immediate latency.

samir: I'll ask forwarder for photos + customs contact. Also requested proof-of-repair docs. If vendor can provide loaner AWB we can crossdock tomorrow.

ellie: Vendor responded — they can issue provisional loaners but want vendor RMA acceptance form signed. They attached a PDF with fields and a scanned COO. They proposed split: 30 units release, 20 held pending inspection.

maria: If we sign provisional RMA, who bears freight? Vendor proposal says split cost: Redwood covers customs brokerage for held units; vendor covers return freight on confirmed DOA. We should push for net-net where Redwood pays only brokerage.

jo: Ops ask: if we accept split (30/20), can infra route canaries to the released 30 and hold rollback policies? We need an automated fallback route to the Dedicated nodes if tail latency crosses 200ms.

alex: Yes — add route rule: if p95 > 180ms for 3m, shift 20% traffic to dedicated pool; fallback TTL 10m. I can PR config.

rma-bot: Ticket created: RMA-2026-058 — vendor docs attached. Assigned to samir + ellie.

samir: Update after call with forwarder: customs wants COI + vendor repair cert. Forwarder can pre-clear if we provide signed RMA acceptance and a letter of financial responsibility for brokerage.

ellie: Proposed plan: 1) Sign provisional RMA acceptance limited to brokerage liability only. 2) Accept 30 released units into EU edge pool tomorrow AM. 3) Move 8 GPUs from non-critical pool -> critical to cover delta. 4) Warm dedicated nodes as standby (alex). 5) Track final inspection for remaining 20 and ship loaners if inspection fails.

maria: Approve plan pending cost cap. Set cost cap at $35k for brokerage + expedited paperwork. If vendor asks > cap, escalate to finance.

jo: I'll open a change with infra runbook and add the p95 fallback. Who will sign the RMA?

ellie: I can sign on operations' behalf but need procurement sign-off (maria).

maria: I approve signature for provisional RMA limited to brokerage up to the cap. Sign and upload to the ticket.

samir: Filing docs now. Forwarder requested manifest snippet in CSV — dropping it here (redacted):

```
AWB,SKU,Quantity,SerialPrefix
CARGO-FTX-894512,H100,50,H100-EDGE-xxxx
```

ellie: Crossdock window booked for 03/18 02:00-06:00 UTC for the 30-release. Alex pls coordinate induction.

alex: On it. Will schedule warm nodes and set autoscale flags. ETA for warm nodes: 75m once booking confirmed.

jo: I'll monitor cluster health and post baseline p95 before canary. Please post updates here.

samir: Uploaded signed provisional RMA to ticket RMA-2026-058 and forwarded to vendor contact (liaison@forwarder.example). Waiting for forwarder pre-clear OK.

ellie: Thanks. If pre-clear hits OK, we do crossdock and mark the thread resolved. If not, we escalate for air replacements. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Finance noted the $35k cap. If we exceed, call me.

alex: FYI for runbook: snippet to add to routing policies:
```
if p95_latency_ms > 180 for 180s -> shift 20% traffic to dedicated-eu-edge, ttl=600s
```

jo: Baseline p95 now: 92ms. Will post hourly.

ellie: Update 40m later: Forwarder confirmed pre-clear pending our signed RMA. They gave us a customs contact: +49-69-555-0123.

samir: Called them — they want scanned signature and a letterhead confirming broker. I've attached both to the ticket. Waiting for release confirmation.

ellie: Noting action items: samir (follow forwarder + confirm release), alex (warm nodes + crossdock induction), jo (monitor p95 + trigger routing), maria (cost sign-off). I'll close thread after cargo releases.

maria: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
